sql: SELECT json_object('type','alias-issue','id',i.issue_id,'candidate_id',i.candidate_id,'canonical_label',i.proposed_label,'concept_type',i.proposed_type,'aliases',json(i.aliases_json),'candidates',json(coalesce((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('concept_id',z.concept_id,'canonical_label',z.canonical_label,'concept_type',z.concept_type)) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c.concept_id,c.canonical_label,c.concept_type FROM concepts c LEFT JOIN aliases a ON a.target_concept_id=c.concept_id AND a.visible_to_generation IS NULL WHERE c.visible_to_generation IS NULL AND c.lifecycle_state<>'retired' AND (lower(c.canonical_label)=lower(i.proposed_label) OR a.normalized_alias=lower(i.proposed_label) OR a.normalized_alias IN(SELECT lower(value) FROM json_each(i.aliases_json))) ORDER BY c.concept_id) z),'[]'))) FROM maintenance_alias_issues i WHERE i.issue_id=?1 AND i.state='open'
query_plan: SEARCH a USING AUTOMATIC PARTIAL COVERING INDEX (target_concept_id=?) LEFT-JOIN

sql: SELECT json_object('type','concept','id',c.concept_id,'canonical_label',c.canonical_label,'concept_type',c.concept_type,'lifecycle',c.lifecycle_state,'version',coalesce((SELECT max(version) FROM concept_versions WHERE concept_id=c.concept_id),0),'aliases',json(coalesce((SELECT json_group_array(normalized_alias) FROM (SELECT normalized_alias FROM aliases WHERE target_concept_id=c.concept_id AND visible_to_generation IS NULL ORDER BY normalized_alias)),'[]'))) FROM concepts c WHERE c.concept_id=?1 AND c.visible_to_generation IS NULL
